metadata.description: Agent plugins bundled with xstockstrat (Cursor catalog)

plugins.name: mcp-tools-docs
plugins.description: Progressive-disclosure reference for the xstockstrat-agent MCP tools, generated from docs/runbooks/mcp-tools.md so a wire-connected agent can consume each tool's parameters, return shape, error cases, and cross-tool usage patterns as a skill.

plugins.name: sdd-suite
plugins.description: xstockstrat's Spec-Driven Development toolchain (the /sdd-* lifecycle skills and the advisory subagents they orchestrate).

plugins.name: strat-lab
plugins.description: A backtesting workbench for this repository's xstockstrat MCP server: ensures data coverage (backfill), runs strategy backtests, survives the >token-limit diagnostics payload by saving-and-parsing, aggregates an independent-per-symbol basket, and verifies results against a pre-change oracle before trusting them.
